proved: A turn persists one selected head while every revision persists its complete parent set and creation, edit, reconciliation, or migration source.
Projection validates an acyclic revision graph and derives every current tip independently of delivery order.
Ordinary editing fails closed while sibling tips exist; reconciliation requires the exact research revision, selected head, and complete exact tip set.
A successful reconciliation appends one attributed revision whose parents are every sibling and deletes no prior body; a late sibling reopens conflict.
The engine-free product makes sibling conflict visible, disables ordinary Edit, and states that every sibling becomes a merge parent.
An already-open editor also fails closed when a sibling arrives without changing the selected head; the draft remains visible and Save is disabled.
The MCP stdio server advertises 37 tools including strict reconcile_scenario_turn routing and schemas.
Valid v1 scenario records migrate deterministically and idempotently after IndexedDB or initial Drive synchronization and before automation publication; malformed or future records write nothing.
